text:
I'm sorry your plant is struggling. Unfortunately, the 90-day guarantee only covers plants ordered while your Leafy Plus membership is active. Since you bought this one before joining, the standard 30-day guarantee applies, and at day 50 it's outside that window, so a replacement claim isn't covered.

A Plant Care Specialist can give you free care advice by chat or email, which may help you save the plant. If you think there are circumstances I haven't covered, I can escalate this to a Support Lead, though I can't promise an exception.
